label: N2 fails at the selected world, by Constructive-proof
meaning: Owner's steps (3)–(4): the existing cause of the spacetime whole is concrete by the activity clause of the weak causal-concreteness floor item, so N2 would make it satisfy the thesis predicate and, by containment, be a part of spacetime, which UNIVERSE-CAUSE-OUTSIDE-SPACETIME excludes. So N2 fails; equivalently N2 commits its holder to no existing cause of the universe or to denying one of the other premises. This does not exclude causal edges from nonexisting candidates; that stronger conclusion would require a causal-endpoint existence premise. Conditional on the open caused-universe premise and bridges.
